description_html:
Wacom ACK-40401- Wireless Accessory Kit

This Wacom Wireless Accessory Kit is a three-piece kit that allows you to easily connect your tablet to your computer without the wires, making tablets more portable. The wireless accessory kit components and battery conveniently plug into the pen tablet and an available USB port on your computer, leaving less clutter and more room for life. A battery that allows you to operate your pen tablet while its charging. A status light will show you when the battery is full charged.

Product Features:

  • Up to 15-hour battery life depending on the size tablet

  • RF wireless technology which offers immediate pairing and avoidance of compatibility issues

  • Wireless operating distance is up to 10 meters

  • Compatible with Intuos5, Bamboo Capture and the Bamboo Create pen tablets

      Box Contains

  • Wacom wireless module

  • Wacom wireless receiver

  • Rechargeable battery

  • Quick start guide
